info.title: Hodhod teacher API
info.description: Implemented endpoints only. Email sign-in and revocable Bearer sessions.

message.example: If delivery succeeds, a sign-in code will arrive shortly

code.description: Six-digit emailed code; 11111 only in explicitly enabled development mode

joinCode.description: Active join code; null for archived classes

id.description: Stable backend content ID; progress and reports always refer to this

unityId.description: Unity identifier of the current published version; may change between versions

contentId.description: Published practice content (kind practice or both)

audience.description: whole_class fixes the recipients to the current members; selected uses studentIds

studentIds.description: Required for selected, forbidden for whole_class. Must all be current members of the class.

startsAt.description: ISO 8601 with UTC offset; defaults to the server time now

endsAt.description: ISO 8601 with UTC offset; must be in the future, after startsAt, and at most 366 days after it

id.description: Every allocation gets a new ID, even for the same content and class

phase.description: Computed from the server clock: upcoming, active, ended, or cancelled

recipients.description: Explicit recipients fixed at creation who are still active members of the class; recipientCount is the original audience size

id.description: Every allocation gets a new ID, even for the same content and class

phase.description: Computed from the server clock: upcoming, active, ended, or cancelled

status.description: Status of this assignment turn only

bestStars.description: Best stars within this turn only

attemptCount.description: Attempts made in this turn only

points.description: Points earned from this turn only (sum of its ledger entries)

students.description: Recipients who are still active members of the class

distribution.description: Number of ratings per value 1 to 4

summary.description: Over all matching ratings, not just this page

items.description: Newest first. Never contains email addresses.

totalDurationSeconds.description: Total play time over all attempts in this turn, seconds

feedbackRating.description: The student's 1-4 interest rating for this game, if given. Independent of stars.
